title: PR previews on Cloudflare: every PR gets its own copy of the site
body:
Every pull request from a branch in this repo gets a link to its own copy of the site, commented on the PR and updated on every push:

**`https://pr-<number>-garden-preview.gardeninsound.workers.dev`**

The live site is untouched: it still deploys from `main` to GitHub Pages.

## How

- **`preview/`:** `garden-preview`, a Cloudflare Worker that only serves files, in the project's account (account id pinned).
- **`.github/workflows/preview.yml`:** builds the PR, then runs `wrangler versions upload --preview-alias pr-<N>`, then comments the link with `gh pr comment --edit-last --create-if-none`.
  - Fork PRs are skipped, since GitHub doesn't give them the token.
  - It uses the `CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN` Actions secret, which has only Workers Scripts: Edit.
- **Previews are full copies of the site.**
  - The relay and the idea box allow `https://*-garden-preview.gardeninsound.workers.dev`. Both are already deployed with this change.
  - Ideas sent from a preview are titled `[preview pr-<N>] Idea: …` (`previewOf` in `wish/src/issue.ts`, tested).
  - The Turnstile widget needs `gardeninsound.workers.dev` in its hostnames.
- **Docs:** `preview/README.md`, `docs/hosting.md` (services, ship flow, secrets, jobs), and CLAUDE.md.

## Tested

- `npm test`, `npm run build` and the `wish/` type check pass.
- Created `garden-preview` and uploaded a test preview by hand: `pr-0-garden-preview.gardeninsound.workers.dev` returns 200 and serves the site.
- Live Workers, checked with `curl`:
  - the relay upgrades a WebSocket from a preview origin (101) and rejects other sites (403);
  - the idea box returns CORS headers for previews only.
- This PR's own preview is the end-to-end test.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)
